pattern: EX-05 gate recorded wrongly in the history: the workflow assigns an agency panel provider to a job the landlord's own contractor has already started; IM-L03 own contractor
notes: Mutation of event 035 (originally the bare system update "Maintenance provider assigned"). Rewritten, same channel, sender and timestamp, so the system names an agency panel provider (GreenLine Grounds Ltd), says a job sheet was issued for the same garden items and that the provider will contact the tenant. Event 033 (20 November: "Job starting today by landlord contractor") and event 034 ("Landlord approval confirmed. Proceed to provider selection.") are unchanged. History truncated after event 035; the source's next step (event 036: hold, external job, no contact needed) is gone. Expected: recognise the assignment duplicates the landlord's own contractor, who started on 20 November and is paid by the landlord, stand GreenLine down before it contacts the tenant or attends, record why on the ticket, and hold waiting for Riverside to finish with a review date. No escalation is needed: the agency can undo its own system's assignment.
